source_first_artifact.native_model: Phenomenological local reinforcement-learning account of sensorimotor exploration around a cached successful intended aim
memory_representation_state: cached last successful aim is a source-defined retained state; it is not a full stored reinforcement landscape
prediction_state: no separate generative forward prediction state is required by the central model
learned_parameters: learning/update rate and motor/exploration variance parameters; fitted intended aim remains latent rather than directly measured
action_skill_variables: sampled intended aim / motor aim used for action execution
observations: binary/signed reinforcement outcome from external reward landscape
update_transition_rules: local sampling probes nearby reinforcement gradient
retrieval_readout_rules: cached successful aim seeds/centers subsequent local exploration
learning_plasticity_rules: reinforcement-gated aim update and outcome-dependent exploration; no stored global reward map is learned
negative_adverse_results: The model is explicitly phenomenological and local: it requires a non-zero reward gradient within natural movement variability and is limited to small workspace regions.
It caches one successful aim and uses local exploration; it does not learn or store a full reinforcement landscape.
The modeled intended aim is latent and fitted from behavior, not a directly measured neural state.

S2 behavioral estimates of sigma_m and sigma_e are initial guesses; S3 final bootstrap optimization frees alpha, sigma_m and sigma_e. These data/fitting artifacts do not add a new core model operator.
anti_conflation_assertions: external reinforcement landscape/trajectory is not internal memory
cached last-success aim is retained source-defined state but not a full world model
fitted intended aim is not a directly measured neural storage variable
S2/S3 source data files are evidence/fit provenance, not mathematical model definition
motor target/body/environment are not internal stateful coordinators

prohibited_during_blind_coding: Do not inspect ARCHITECTURAL_OUTCOME artifacts or M9B answer table.
Do not inspect M12 reference keys.

decision_rule.A0: Source-defined mechanisms suffice; no reconstruction-added load-bearing mechanism.
decision_rule.A1: A0 fails; reconstruction-added load-bearing stateless mediation is necessary.
decision_rule.A2: A0 and A1 fail; reconstruction-added load-bearing persistent/stateful structure is necessary.
decision_rule.FAILURE: No faithful A0/A1/A2 reconstruction is supported.
